title: COHCAP Analysis of CpG Island Methylation for Illumina 450k Methylation Arrays
protocol: Process raw data using Genome Studio to produce a table of beta values.
Download raw data from the provided link if .idat files are not available on GEO entry.
Open R to run _minfi_ package for pre-processing and create COHCAP input file.
Set the working directory to the extracted "Protocol_Exchange_Example" folder.
Load the minfi library in R.
Define idat.folder as "5958154021".
Read the 450k experiment data using read.450k.exp() with idat.folder.
Preprocess Illumina data using preprocessIllumina(), correcting background and normalizing controls.
Get beta values from methyl.norm using getBeta().
Create a dataframe with SiteID as probes and beta.table contents.
Write the output table to a text file named minfi.txt, separated by tabs without quotes or row names.
Load the COHCAP library in R.
Define sample.file as "COHCAP_sample_description.txt".
Get the project folder using getwd().
Assign project.name as "COHCAP_450k_Protocol_Exchange".
Annotate beta.table with COHCAP.annotate() using specified parameters.
Perform quality control on the samples and data table with COHCAP.qc().
Download IGV from the provided link.
Open IGV.
Set the genome reference to hg19.
Import .wig files using "File --> Load from File".
Load other tracks, such as CpG Islands, if desired.
Enter the region of interest in the form chrA:pos1-pos2 or a gene symbol.
Use "Tracks --> Fit Data to Window" to expand the tracks for better visualization.
Export a screenshot of the view using "File --> Save Image".
